# Insights — Altium 365 API
> Workspace insights about parts and designs.

Concepts: [insights](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/cdm/subsets/insights/). Schema slice: [schema.graphql](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/schema.graphql) (~4668 tokens). Overview: [overview](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/overview.md).

## Entities
- [DesWorkspaceInsInsight](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/types/objects/des-workspace-ins-insight.md): Part Insight. GRID `grid:workspace:{workspace-id}:insights:insight/{id}`. Via: desWorkspaceInsInsightById, desWorkspaceInsInsightByName, desWorkspaceInsInsights

## Entry points
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-by-id.md): Gets an insight by its identifier.
- [desWorkspaceInsInsights](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insights.md) (list): Gets a list of insights.

## Queries
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightByName](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-by-name.md): Gets an insight by its name.
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightSeverities](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-severities.md): Gets all available insight severities.
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightSortingFields](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-sorting-fields.md): Gets all available insight sorting fields.
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightStatuses](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-statuses.md): Gets all available insight statuses.
- [desWorkspaceInsInsightTypes](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-insight-types.md): Gets all available insight types.
- [desWorkspaceInsNotificationSettings](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-notification-settings.md): Gets the notification settings.
- [desWorkspaceInsSettings](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/queries/des-workspace-ins-settings.md): Gets the settings.

## Mutations
- [desWorkspaceInsInitializeInsightsIfRequired](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-initialize-insights-if-required.md): Runs the initialization process for insights, if didn't run yet.
- [desWorkspaceInsUnsubscribeFromNotifications](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-unsubscribe-from-notifications.md): Unsubscribes from notifications.
- [desWorkspaceInsUpdateInsightById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-update-insight-by-id.md): Updates an insight by identifier.
- [desWorkspaceInsUpdateNotificationSettings](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-update-notification-settings.md): Updates the notification settings.
- [desWorkspaceInsUpdateSettings](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-update-settings.md): Updates the settings.
- [desWorkspaceInsUpsertInsightByKey](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/platform-api-docs/reference/insights/operations/mutations/des-workspace-ins-upsert-insight-by-key.md): Creates or updates an insight by key.
